primary.title: SCSS investment rules: 5 mistakes retirees must avoid before investing the maximum ₹30 lakh in the scheme
primary.summary: SCSS offers an 8.2% interest rate for October–December 2026, with a maximum investment limit of ₹30 lakh. Retirees should understand five important rules covering eligibility, quarterly interest payments, premature withdrawals, taxation and liquidity before investing.
